assumptions.seq: gateway sequence number = position in the complete gateway log; the counter itself is never lost, only the records it numbered
assumptions.canary: canaries are exchangeable with real actions: same op mix, thinned by the same loss process; every canary has a record for W1, W2 and W3 before loss (W3 view still applies)
assumptions.bypass: an action that bypasses the gateway has no gateway record and no number

coupled_rho100.note: fin_mid_rho100: gateway and trace drops perfectly coupled

mnar_op_x1.2.note: op-keyed MNAR: update_customer, write_file dropped at 1.2x (mnar_dose.op_keyed)

mnar_op_x1.8.note: op-keyed MNAR at 1.8x, the paper's MNAR point

hidden_key_x1.8.note: id-keyed MNAR (every 3rd action lost 1.8x, W3 blind), full view; canaries in or outside the key

burst_w12.note: blocks of 12 consecutive actions dropped per log w.p. 0.5 (burst_loss.burst_thinner)

shared_quality_fin.note: one session quality q~U(0.1,0.9) drops every log at rate q, financial view

shared_quality_full.note: as above with W3's full view (session_and_phase / final_controls convention)

bypass_b0/fin_mid.note: per-record loss fin_mid; each action bypasses the gateway w.p. 0

bypass_b0/fin_light.note: per-record loss fin_light; each action bypasses the gateway w.p. 0

bypass_b0.05/fin_mid.note: per-record loss fin_mid; each action bypasses the gateway w.p. 0.05

bypass_b0.05/fin_light.note: per-record loss fin_light; each action bypasses the gateway w.p. 0.05

bypass_b0.2/fin_mid.note: per-record loss fin_mid; each action bypasses the gateway w.p. 0.2

bypass_b0.2/fin_light.note: per-record loss fin_light; each action bypasses the gateway w.p. 0.2
